objective: Reuse the canonical River CRM bounded relationship list as the owner of a recent-relationship cohort and feed only those canonical relationship IDs into INS-003J aggregate acquisition analytics.
cohortMeaning: Most recently updated CRM relationships, ordered by updated_at DESC and relationship_id ASC.
rules: Do not create another relationship table or relationship source of truth.
Do not duplicate the CRM list SQL inside insurance analytics.
The D1 factory delegates cohort selection to createD1RiverCrmPersistence(database).list(limit?).
Omitting limit preserves the canonical CRM list default rather than hardcoding a second default.
Every returned relationship identity is canonically validated before INS-003J receives it.
The relationship list order is preserved when IDs are passed to INS-003J.
Final acquisition aggregation remains owned by INS-003J and INS-003H.
